'''Seta-Le''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who visited the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] holy [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While trekking through the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] to a meditation site, Seta-Le fell through a patch of [[Water/Legends|ice]] into a cavern and became trapped, with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] broken by the fall. However, she managed to use her [[Weapon/Legends|weapon's]] components with the cave's [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] formations to generate a scattered beam that melted through the ice wall of the cave, allowing her to escape. The ice formations left behind by the beam subsequently became a point of interest for other Jedi pilgrims.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seta-Le was mentioned in the "Jedi Pilgrimages" Codex entry in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
